analysis_policy: 3 training seeds and8 test actors are distinct axes; descriptive means/SD and paired per-seed differences, no iid clip p-values or general multimodal-model superiority. All test metrics reported; no post-test best-arm adoption.
cost_policy: Equal256 updates;600 attempted-update CPU cap yields censoring. Report active parameters, logical/physical state bytes, peakprocessRSS, all dev/setup/import/shutdown/failures separately. Body/worker/stage are nested and never added twice; joules unknown.
holdout_policy: 8 actors outside three inspected prior actor manifests; official192 clip roster fixed before download. All9 terminal fits and checkpoints globally sealed before any test scoring. No test-driven selection/retry. Data decoded offline before fitting; all source/cache hashes bound. Failed/censored attempts remain denominators.

model.frontend: independent modality Linear(130,8) + tanh; same seeded frontend across arms
model.hcsn: qualified FastSignedHCSN a92d7cc45af0ccf1e1c2629ee9fe8ef1d4b0bc6dba335bbdc53cd909c42d80b3; QVI/value-risk, signed-only, mixed, uniformized, scripted action, interval cache, no core classifier
model.lif: binary threshold/reset, .9 leak, recurrent width8; fast-sigmoid surrogate, detached reset; mean pool
model.projection: time mean -> modality Linear to32; shared6-class classifier; fused mean logits
model.time: 32 normalized offline positions; dt=.25; final two input channels t/31 and1/32 identical across clips; real elapsed/dt never read by model
model.transformer: one causal 8-wide 2-head block, FF16, dropout0; mean pool

negative_control: Duration-only nearest neighbor after all9 seal; metadata are excluded from every learned model input.
primary_metrics: paired recording retrieval R@1,R@5,MRR both directions, all and withinactor
cross-actor emotion retrieval classR@1 and mAP, same actor removed from entire gallery
revision: Before any AV fitting/test scoring, discarded real-duration inputs that could directly identify pairs; originalproposal/data/source/error receipts retained.
scope: Genuine paired audiovisual low-level offline encoder on acted-emotion clips. Not a foundation model, online timing benchmark, raw-media end-to-end encoder, or generative all-modality training claim.

training.loss: fused CE + .25(audio CE + video CE) + .5 symmetric InfoNCE, temperature .1
training.selection: minimum development fused CE, including initialization step0; first occurrence wins ties
